players.product: insulated building wire and LV / MV power cable

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-12-2026, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 467,310M vs KRW 302,686M in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 18,396M vs KRW 13,721M; H1 net profit KRW 14,724M vs KRW 11,650M. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 278,068M (Q2 2025: KRW 151,420M), operating profit KRW 3,727M (Q2 2025: KRW 5,396M). Segments: wire and cable revenue KRW 354,095M (H1 2025: KRW 249,487M) with segment operating profit KRW 15,506M; automotive aluminium wheels (Daewon Altec, consolidated since 2025) KRW 113,216M with segment operating profit KRW 2,893M. Parent-only: revenue KRW 340,038M, operating profit KRW 13,855M.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 467,310M (H1 2025 KRW 302,686M); H1 OP KRW 18,396M (H1 2025 KRW 13,721M); Q2 revenue KRW 278,068M, Q2 OP KRW 3,727M; wire and cable revenue KRW 354,095M

quarterly_data.signal: Wire and cable capacity and utilisation (section II-3): H1 2026 production capacity at the Yesan plant KRW 395,043M (value basis; FY2025 KRW 583,761M) against production of KRW 316,034M (FY2025 KRW 467,008M), with average utilisation of 93.79% (3,264 of 3,480 available hours). Capacity by product: insulated wire KRW 227,838M, power cable KRW 129,071M, bare wire KRW 22,343M, communication cable KRW 11,700M. The aluminium-wheel plant (Wanju) ran at 95.76% utilisation, producing 1,623 thousand wheels against capacity of 1,695 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Cable capacity KRW 395,043M, production KRW 316,034M, utilisation 93.79%; wheels 1,623k of 1,695k capacity, utilisation 95.76%

quarterly_data.signal: Order position for 2026 deliveries (January-June): orders received 33,860 tonnes / KRW 407,474M, delivered 29,022 tonnes / KRW 349,262M, leaving an order backlog of 4,836 tonnes / KRW 58,212M (insulated wire KRW 35,571M, power cable KRW 17,913M, bare wire KRW 3,062M, communication cable KRW 1,666M). The company states it has no long-term supply contract material to its financial statements.
quarterly_data.figure: Order backlog 4,836 tonnes / KRW 58,212M (orders KRW 407,474M, delivered KRW 349,262M)

quarterly_data.signal: Wire and cable product mix, H1 2026: insulated wire KRW 213,421M (60%), power cable KRW 107,476M (31%), bare wire KRW 18,371M (5%), communication cable KRW 9,995M (3%), other KRW 4,832M (1%); exports KRW 26,338M of the KRW 354,095M total. Prices track LME copper: domestic power-cable price KRW 19,824/kg (FY2025 KRW 15,164/kg) and insulated-wire price KRW 22,500/kg (FY2025 KRW 17,158/kg), while copper rod cost KRW 19,628/kg (FY2025 KRW 14,404/kg); LME copper averaged USD 13,088.09/ton in H1 2026, up 24.06%. Public demand from KEPCO and KT is about 30% of the market; the company describes a dominant share in building insulated wire and says it is investing to expand automotive wire production.
quarterly_data.figure: Insulated wire KRW 213,421M (60%), power cable KRW 107,476M (31%); power cable KRW 19,824/kg; copper rod KRW 19,628/kg; LME USD 13,088.09/ton

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (segment note): two unnamed external customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026 -- customer A KRW 69,711,312 thousand (14.92%) and customer B KRW 65,438,129 thousand (14.00%), up from 11.84% and 7.67% in H1 2025. In the parent-only accounts customer A is 20.50% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 14.92% (KRW 69,711,312 thousand); customer B 14.00% (KRW 65,438,129 thousand); parent-only customer A 20.50%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and R&D, H1 2026: wire and cable capex (new lines, expansion and upgrades) KRW 1,177,136 thousand; aluminium-wheel capex (automation and equipment) KRW 2,442,394 thousand, with 2026 wheel investment aimed at automation and capacity expansion. Cable R&D spend KRW 412,845 thousand (0.12% of revenue). Recent certifications: EPR-insulated 5-35kV MV cable UL 1072 (completed 2026.03) and TR-XLPE 5-35kV MV cable UL 1072 and CSA C68.10 (completed 2025.11), aimed at US federal and overseas orders.
quarterly_data.figure: Cable capex KRW 1,177,136 thousand; wheel capex KRW 2,442,394 thousand; cable R&D KRW 412,845 thousand (0.12%)
